portals.note: Opened after a 301 redirect from miamidade.gov/pa. The page describes a search of Miami-Dade properties and offers folio number, address, name and subdivision search. Fee status is not stated. No folio search was run for parcel 3059360000050.

facts.summary: The Wikipedia article on Naval Air Station Richmond says the University of Miami has used the former base as a research facility and storage area since 1948. The article does not name the parcel, so the link to atlas parcel 3059360000050 is unconfirmed.
facts.authority: Wikipedia (secondary source on the former Naval Air Station Richmond)
facts.quote: Since 1948, the University of Miami has used it as a research facility and storage area.

gaps: The USACE Jacksonville District Richmond NAS page returned HTTP 403, so the official list of current owners could not be read. The current-owner list in the search summary is unverified.
The USACE Richmond NAS FUDS community relations plan at the USACE digital library returned no readable text.
No folio search was run in the Miami-Dade Property Appraiser, so the parcel's owner, sale and tax history are unknown.
Miami-Dade Clerk official records and the Richmond Heights building and zoning records were not opened, so deeds, liens and permits are unknown.
The search summary said FCI Miami may sit on former base land. The FCI Miami Wikipedia page does not mention the base, so that link is unconfirmed and no fact is recorded.
Acreage sources conflict (2,100, 2,000 and 2,500 acres in search summaries). None of these was verified against a fetched page, so no acreage fact is recorded.

facts.summary: A 2018 news report describes the former Conway Bombing and Gunnery Range as covering more than 55,000 acres, including parts of Carolina Forest. The same report's 'unacceptable risk' finding is attributed to three of four range sites, not named as Conway.
facts.reference: Report: Former Horry County bombing range sites pose unacceptable risk, Aug 9, 2018 (updated Aug 16, 2018)
facts.quote: The former Conway Bombing and Gunnery Range covers more than 55,000 acres, including parts of Carolina Forest.

gaps: The USACE Savannah District Conway BGR project page returned HTTP 403, so the Corps' acreage, acquisition, surplus and current-ownership statements could not be read.
The USACE 2018 Conway BGR fact sheet PDF returned HTTP 403, so it could not be checked.
The WBTW report on the Corps' plan for no further remediation returned HTTP 403, so the date and munitions response site named in that plan are unknown.
The 2025 Record of Decision for Range III was found in search results but not opened, so no decision is recorded.
The Army-versus-Air Force role in the range is unresolved. The search summaries disagree, and neither was verified against a fetched page.

The atlas owner list (multiple private owners) was not checked against any parcel record, and the atlas parcel id is null. Horry County parcel search was not run, so no owner, sale or tax record is recorded.
The Horry County plat-notation and impact-safety-zone policy was described in a search summary but was not opened, so it is not recorded as a fact.
